name: 29824 · Edgefield, SC
findings: ZIP 29824 (Edgefield) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29824 (Edgefield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29824 (Edgefield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
